detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Turn space junk into rockets

Rocket Scrapyard is a cozy first-person collecting game. Tidy up the scrapyard of a private space company, sort rocket parts into sets on your racks, build your own rocket every evening and watch it launch the next morning.

Collect

Every day a new delivery of discarded rocket parts lands on a clean, high-tech scrapyard. Pick them up into packages – or suck them in with the vacuum – and carry them to the hall. Clear a zone and the next one opens. Now and then an exceptional part hides in the scrap and makes its whole set better – and somewhere out there are the director's 20 lost figurines.

Fill the racks

Five parts of a kind make a complete set and earn XP. Incomplete sets merge on the shelves, worn ones can be sold, and the auto-sell panel clears out the weakest at the end of the day.

Repair

Worn parts get a second life at the workbench. Every evening take a few of them in hand – weld seams, grind off rust, calibrate engine nozzles – and a short mini-game decides how much better they come out.

Build

In the evening the assembly station lists everything on your racks. Stack engines, fuel tanks, nose cones, fins, boosters, stage separators and parachutes into your own rocket and watch its stats change with every part. Licenses for bigger parts even raise the roof of the hall.

Launch

Every morning your rocket lifts off and the flight plays out: altitude milestones, stage separation, parachutes, failures, the edge of space and – with a flight computer – orbit. Come back down too fast and exposed parts glow red-hot and burn up. Every launch adds a photo to the wall in the hall.

Grow

Spend XP on upgrades: more packages, a vacuum, a courier drone, taller and extra racks, licenses for bigger parts. Take orders from clients – satellites, aerial photos, sample returns, station modules – build up your own spaceport and finish a space station in orbit.

Features

  • A relaxed daily loop: collect by day, build in the evening, launch in the morning

  • Over 30 rocket parts with their own looks, stats, wear and rarity, plus mission payloads

  • Simulated flights with stages, orbits, re-entry heating and an orbit map

  • Over 25 upgrades, over 20 kinds of client orders, 8 spaceport buildings and a six-module space station

  • Workbench mini-games, 20 hidden figurines and 30 Steam achievements

  • Five minutes on the clock each day – or start a game with no time limit

  • Full gamepad support, playable on Steam Deck

  • Interface and subtitles in 25 languages
